functionHooks.text: extern void rocket_widescreen_frustum_begin(uint8_t*, recomp_context*); rocket_widescreen_frustum_begin(rdram, ctx);
functionHooks.reason: Expand-to-window widens RT64's projection after Rocket has already performed its CPU object-frustum test. Widen only the guest camera's two horizontal side planes immediately before the retail frustum_test body so objects that are genuinely visible outside the authored 4:3 view are retained, while Original 4:3 and render-distance logic remain unchanged.
